title: There's a park near here
subtitle: Places in the neighborhood — Is there…? How many…?
canDo: I can name places in a town.
I can ask: Is there a … near here? How many … are there?
teacherNotes: Warm-up: Öğrencilerin evlerinin yakınındaki 3 yeri söylemelerini isteyin; bilmedikleri yer adlarını ekrana yazın.
Arap öğrenciler "كم"den sonra tekil kullandıkları için "How many book…?" der. İngilizcede How many + çoğul.
Türk öğrenciler de "Kaç kitap" tekil olduğu için aynı hatayı yapar. Tahtada "How many + ___s" kalıbını gösterin.
Oyun: Bir öğrenci evinin yakınında olan / olmayan şeyleri düşünür, diğerleri "Is there a … near your home?" diye sorarak tahmin eder.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Welcome to Harbor Street!
sections.intro: A page from a small guide for new students.
paragraphs: Harbor Street is a small street, but there are a lot of places.
There's a bank, a pharmacy and a post office.
There are two bookstores and three cafés — but Sam's café is the best!
There isn't a cinema, but there's a library next to the park.
On Saturdays, there's a market in the park.
There are a lot of people, and there's fresh fruit, bread and flowers.

items.prompt: How many cafés are there on Harbor Street?

sections.title: Grammar: Is there…? How many…?
look: **Is there** a pharmacy near here? — Yes, **there is**.
There are **a lot of** places on Harbor Street.

head: Question
Answer
rows: Is there a bank near here?
Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
There are a lot of people!

rules: **How many** + plural noun + **are there**? — How many caf**és** are there?
**a lot of** = many: a lot of cafés, a lot of people
Short answers: Yes, there **is**. / No, there **aren't**.
examples: Is there a bank near here? — Yes, there is.
How many students are there in your class?
There are a lot of books in the library.

support.tr: Kaç tane olduğunu sormak için How many … are there? kullanılır: How many cafés are there? = Kaç kafe var? How many'den sonra isim çoğul olur (Türkçedeki "kaç kafe" gibi tekil değil). "Çok" için a lot of: a lot of books = bir sürü kitap.
support.ar: للسؤال عن العدد نقول: How many … are there? = كم … يوجد؟ مثال: How many cafés are there? = كم مقهى يوجد؟ لاحظ: بعد How many يأتي الاسم بصيغة الجمع (cafés)، على عكس العربية حيث يأتي بعد «كم» مفردًا. و a lot of = كثير من.

tr.note: How many'den sonra isim çoğul olur; birden fazla şey için there are.
wrong: There is a lot of cafés.
right: There are a lot of cafés.

ar.note: بعد How many استخدم الجمع، وليس المفرد كما بعد «كم» في العربية.
